STOP and listen to the sky’s quiet announcement.  
The Sun has slipped into Libra, inviting the world to pause and balance what feels off‑center. Think of a crowded kitchen where everyone’s plates are uneven—now imagine the chef rearranging them so each plate is the same height. The Equinox asks you to weigh your commitments, to straighten the scales between work, family, and self‑care. Notice the gentle pressure to find equilibrium, and respond by setting one clear boundary today, like a firm “no” to an extra task that would tilt your day. This act is your anchor, your way of keeping the day balanced and your energy grounded.  
Take a moment, set that boundary, and step into balance.
